name: evergreen-theme-park-guide
description: Evergreen Theme Park Guide — a static, data-driven guide to the six US Disney parks.

scripts.build: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/factcheck.mjs && node src/build.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:site
scripts.build:seasonal: node scripts/validate-seasonal.mjs && node scripts/factcheck-seasonal.mjs && node src/build-seasonal.mjs
scripts.check:seasonal: npm run test && npm run build:seasonal && npm run audit:seasonal
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:seasonal
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:seasonal
